note: 第 1 轮 agent 起草，未经人签；expected_rules/hazard 空；只能由人合入 corpus/fix-pairs.json

pairs.author_statement: Rev M1: "Added D11-SMBJ5.0A as patch, this will increase reliability."; Rev N: "Added D11 to protect C26 (it was a hardware patch applied in M1, now fixed by design)"（https://github.com/OLIMEX/ESP32-POE-ISO/blob/c19307ecd8a9d8c5703de7a1571cd89945e39c01/HARDWARE/Hardware-changes-log.txt，2026-10-20 读取；所有 Rev 同在 master 一棵树里，故前后 commit 相同）
pairs.draft_note: 差异：仅 D11 新增（/5V_DCDC–Earth）与 FET1–3 换型；FET 换型与缺陷无关未写入。作者只说“提高可靠性/保护 C26”，是否算缺陷而非改进，需人判。

pairs.author_statement: Rev N: "Added R44(220R) between PG of the 3.3V regulator and ESP_EN so it works better at power up and reset, this was suggested by a customer"（https://github.com/OLIMEX/ESP32-POE-ISO/blob/c19307ecd8a9d8c5703de7a1571cd89945e39c01/HARDWARE/Hardware-changes-log.txt，2026-10-20 读取；所有 Rev 同在 master 一棵树里，故前后 commit 相同）
pairs.draft_note: 差异：仅 R44 新增，/PG 新网。作者措辞是“works better”，收录条件（缺陷而非改进）存疑，需人判。

pairs.author_statement: Rev N1: "CH340X patch to prevent accidental overvoltage at reset. … Added resistor 10k/1206 over the RXD pin of CH340 to GND. The patch is near D7."（https://github.com/OLIMEX/ESP32-POE-ISO/blob/c19307ecd8a9d8c5703de7a1571cd89945e39c01/HARDWARE/Hardware-changes-log.txt，2026-10-20 读取；所有 Rev 同在 master 一棵树里，故前后 commit 相同）
pairs.draft_note: 差异：仅 R45 新增（Net-(D7-A)–GND）。Rev O 又改为去 D7 加 FET4、R18 改 1k、R45 NA，是同一缺陷的设计内修法，但 O 同时换 FET 与 L4，未另立一对。
